description:
Split from fz-mue.7 (user approved the split 2026-11-20, relayed by Optimize; page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.7.html, Decision 1 and 3).

iterator(M) is [0 | M], an improper list whose tail is the map (maps.erl:1060), so this waits on fz-sc8.22.2.

- :erts_internal.map_next/3 iterator mode: one descent to the position, then a linked batch of up to 32 {K, V, Next} tuples ending in [Path' | Map] or none. The position is fz's entry index, not BEAM's 4-bits-per-level path; map_locate is the existing cursor, nothing is added for it.
- iterator/1, next/1 and fold/3 ported clause for clause from maps.erl.
- Elixir's Map.filter, reject, split_with and map use :maps.iterator/next (map.ex:254, 933, 1154, 1191); fz's versions move to that shape here, so there is one walk per idea, and their own walks are deleted.
- Floor: bench/maps/floor/walk.s gains fz_map_next_batch(map, index, bump); harness checks concatenated batches against the reference walk. probes.py gains next and fold rows at 40 and 100,000 keys (fz, floor, BEAM). BEAM per entry: next-sum 336/273, fold-sum 171/134. Predicted fz: next < 200, fold < 260. A miss is explained before landing, not waived.
- Punch /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/14_maps_iterator_next.fz and the fold part of 15 become fixtures (fz-mue block; check open PRs for the next free number).
- Docs: .agent/docs/modules.md, any-value.md (walk paragraph names map_next), bench/maps/README.md.

Owner: Optimize.
title: :maps.iterator/1, next/1 and fold/3 walk a map in batches, as maps.erl writes them
